title: Serve receipt-bound owned community history through the canonical private console
problem: Portable signed community data exists but GREG cannot serve its posts/history privately. Close that executable product gap without treating signed member records or filesystem presence as authority.
baseline: Linked FM-OWNED-COMMUNITY-JOURNEYS-20261001 and FM-OCI-20261002. Existing console owns loopback/Host protections, owned_pages verifies canonical Gate receipts. System32 signed history already validates and exports.

alternatives.name: simplest_viable_alternative
alternatives.description: Use existing console and receipt verifier plus guarded read-only system32 queries.
disadvantages: Requires receipt-bound hash and escaped bounded pagination.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Remaining network/moderation requirements and new runtime evidence.

alternatives.name: strongest_competing_architecture
alternatives.description: Independent authenticated public community service with enrollment and moderation.
disadvantages: Public deployment, transport authentication and moderation remain further implementation/authorization dependencies; not needed for this private read surface.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Remaining network/moderation requirements and new runtime evidence.

alternatives.name: reversible_experiment
alternatives.description: Signed fixture Body ingestion then real loopback HTML/JSON export and restore with hostile history/Host tests.
advantages: Exercises the actual product path with no public activation.
disadvantages: Fixture key/member records cannot prove real community demand or founder use.
alternatives.revival_evidence: Remaining network/moderation requirements and new runtime evidence.

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Leave feasible private community serving unfinished after record tests.
disadvantages: Does not advance the integrated owned-company experience.

roles.position: Make existing community useful through the existing console; retain network enrollment, moderation, public deployment and real member use as active requirements. Distinct perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: A private read-only page is not the complete community or machine.

roles.position: Share the existing canonical receipt validator with owned pages; extend ingestion receipts with actual community/history hash; use guarded query copies. Distinct perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: A new server or direct filesystem reader would create parallel owners or expose unapproved state.

roles.position: Require chain/witness/grant-dispatch/successful receipt plus current history hash. A valid signed but unreceipted prefix must return404. Escape all content. Distinct perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: Member signature validity alone could authorize serving changed history.

roles.position: Bound console pages and portable JSON export to eight records, paginate by offset, preserve current page receipt behavior and actual company integration. Distinct perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: Large escaped posts could overflow worker output or incomplete pagination could hide history.

roles.position: Test real HTTP Host refusal, valid signed export/restore, unreceipted files and valid-prefix substitution. No community mutation HTTP endpoint or public binding. Distinct perspectives of one agent, not independent reviewers.
material_concerns: Private key possession may be misrepresented as human identity or customer acquisition.

evidence.finding: Local22passed before final bounded-pagination adjustment; fresh focused tests and hosted full suite still required for final delta.

counterevidence.finding: False: network enrollment, moderation/public deployment and real member evidence remain open.

rejected_alternatives.rejection_reason: Public deployment, transport authentication and moderation remain further implementation/authorization dependencies; not needed for this private read surface. Wider requirements remain binding.
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: Authorized deployment and implemented transport/moderation proof.

pass_2.attack_summary: Attack direct filesystem admission, signature-only authority, stale valid prefixes, HTML injection, quota overflow and local-page completion claims.

new_weaknesses.statement: Deleting a signed final leave event leaves a cryptographically valid prefix.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Bind current full history hash to canonical latest successful ingestion receipt; test valid-prefix change refuses both HTML and JSON.

new_weaknesses.statement: Separate projection/hash reads could disagree; escaped long posts could exceed worker output.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Render from one loaded signed history snapshot and use eight-record console queries under existing output ceilings.

new_weaknesses.statement: Owned page and community admission could diverge into separate receipt policies.
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: Extract one shared existing receipt validator without adding grants or authorities; retain page tests.

entries.position: A private signed-history interface does not complete the broader community.
entries.rationale: Network enrollment/moderation and real use remain unfinished.
entries.evidence_threshold: Implemented remaining behavior and appropriate live evidence.
entries.review_trigger: Any community or full-machine completion claim.

migration_plan: Extend canonical community ingestion receipts and company initialization output; share console receipt checks; add private routes; preserve all old data and authority.

steps: Revert new serving routes/shared helper and receipt metadata additions; preserve original signed history and negative evidence.

kill_criteria: Valid unreceipted history publicly or privately served.
History hash mismatch or HTML injection accepted.
Page serving creates grants or writes community state.
Private proof treated as full machine closure.
decision_owner: Kernel/GREG maintainers within authorized development; Alfonso owns consequential decisions
review_trigger: Fresh focused/hosted evidence; then automatically continue parent Body + Organs + Mind objective.
